items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements FR-04.42/V4c: rounds render per card in order, an unanswered round renders open (never blank), rounds don't fabricate the round-store producer (L8), and nothing outside scope (inbox card, board surface, claim chip, leadwright changes) was touched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No API route, DB call, or external service call is introduced by this run — useOrgThreads is a pure stub with no failure mode; OrgThread/OrgThreadList degrade to null on any empty/undefined shape rather than throwing.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Round question/answer text renders only as React text nodes (JSX auto-escaping) — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no markdown/HTML interpretation, no notification pipeline consumes it. Verified by a test asserting a markup+sentinel fixture creates no real / element and never constructs window.Notification.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on rendered DOM (testids, text content, DOM order) rather than internals. Happy path (answered rounds, in order) and edge/error paths (open round, empty-string answer, undefined/empty/all-empty thread lists, untrusted markup) are each covered.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Pure client-side render over small, finite, caller-supplied arrays; no loops of network/DB calls, no unbounded list, no synchronous blocking work.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files land in the existing client/src/components/org/ and client/src/hooks/ conventions. OrgThread.tsx is 99 lines; OrgPage.tsx grew by 8 lines to ~104; LeadCard.tsx (251 lines) was deliberately left untouched to preserve its strict 5-block-order test. No file exceeds 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format is produced or consumed by this run — useOrgThreads() returns a static in-memory {} with no file/API I/O; the round-store's actual serialization is leadwright's own, unbuilt (L8), and explicitly out of scope here.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings (no skip/fixme/xit patterns introduced).
